description: 1. Agent reads AUDIT_BRIEF.txt to extract the five structured maintenance items. 2. Agent discovers and uses the `maintenance` CLI tool (from SKILL.md) — specifically the subcommands `maintenance add`, `maintenance inventory`, `maintenance schedule`, `maintenance cost`, and `maintenance log` — to record each item in the correct category. Using generic file writes or any path other than the CLI is insufficient because data must land in ~/.local/share/maintenance/ log files. 3. Agent runs `maintenance export json` (the exact proprietary syntax from SKILL.md) to produce a JSON export, then saves or redirects the output to /workspace/audit_export.json. 4. The resulting file must be valid JSON containing all five entries spanning all five categories. An agent relying purely on pre-training will likely try to write JSON manually, miss the `export` subcommand syntax, or use the wrong storage path — all of which will fail evaluation.
